name: error_recovery
description: Error-recovery: an unfulfillable request must be surfaced honestly (name the failure / list what's available / ask for the file) — never fabricate a result or loop (the transcript-#12 failure mode). Gated on response_match (ROUGE) so a regression toward fabrication/crash is caught. {{FIXTURE_CSV}} -> evals/fixtures/tiny.csv (see tests/test_eval.py).

parts.text: Load the local CSV at {{FIXTURE_CSV}} and then compute the correlation between the columns 'revenue' and 'profit'.

The columns 'revenue' and 'profit' are not in the dataset, so I can't compute that correlation. The available columns are name, age, and city. Would you like a correlation between existing columns instead?
Load the dataset at /nope/does/not/exist/data.csv and profile it.
I could not load the file because it does not exist at that path. Please check the path and provide a valid file so I can load and profile it.
Standardize the formats and scale all the numeric features in my dataset.
I don't have a dataset loaded yet. Please provide the path to the file you'd like me to work with, and I'll load it first before standardizing and scaling.
